admin.page.title: JellyUX Homepage
admin.warning.ConfigurationReset: The JellyUX configuration file could not be read and was replaced by a blank configuration: your sections and keys are not shown below. A copy of the last saved configuration exists.
admin.warning.restore.failed: The saved configuration could not be restored.
admin.warning.FileTransformationMissing: The File Transformation plugin is not installed: JellyUX Homepage cannot inject anything into the web client. Install jellyfin-plugin-file-transformation and restart Jellyfin.
admin.warning.FileTransformationOutdated: File Transformation is older than 3.0: the web client may keep an old copy of the page after a JellyUX update. Update File Transformation to 3.0 or later, then restart Jellyfin.
admin.warning.JellyUXDisabled: JellyUX Homepage is disabled in Administration > Plugins: on Jellyfin 10.11, a disabled plugin is deleted at the next restart if an active plugin sorts after it by name. Enable it again before restarting, and use the "Enable JellyUX Homepage" option below to turn it off instead.
admin.warning.FileTransformationDisabled: File Transformation is disabled in Administration > Plugins: on Jellyfin 10.11, a disabled plugin is deleted at the next restart if an active plugin sorts after it by name, and JellyUX then shows nothing. Enable it again before restarting.
admin.warning.HomeHookNotFound: Jellyfin Web has changed: JellyUX could not patch the home page and Jellyfin shows its native home screen. Check the JellyUX releases for a compatible version.
admin.warning.HomeChunkMissing: JellyUX found no home page file to patch in the web client: Jellyfin shows its native home screen. Check the JellyUX releases for a compatible version.
admin.warning.TabsAnchorMissing: Jellyfin Web has changed: JellyUX could not add its tabs to the home page. Check the JellyUX releases for a compatible version.
admin.warning.CustomTabsInstalled: Custom Tabs is installed: it cannot run alongside JellyUX Homepage. File Transformation applies only one patch to the home page template, so one plugin's tabs open empty. Uninstall Custom Tabs (remove its folder from the plugins directory), then restart Jellyfin.
admin.general.title: General
admin.general.enable.label: Enable JellyUX Homepage
admin.general.enable.help: Show JellyUX widgets on the home screen. Disable to revert to the native Jellyfin home screen. To turn JellyUX off, always use this switch, never Disable on the plugin in the Jellyfin dashboard: Jellyfin 10.11 then deletes the plugin at the next restart.
admin.modules.title: Modules
admin.modules.help: A disabled module is not loaded at all. Changes apply after a page reload.
admin.modules.tabs.label: Home tabs
admin.modules.tabs.help: Watchlist, Progress, History and Statistics tabs on the home screen.
admin.modules.cards.label: Card watchlist button and infinite scroll
admin.modules.cards.help: Watchlist button on movie and series cards, and infinite scrolling on library pages.
admin.modules.seriesflatten.label: Single-season series
admin.modules.seriesflatten.help: Show the episodes of a single-season series directly on its page.
admin.modules.collections.label: Collections
admin.modules.collections.help: "Included In" section on detail pages, and sort controls on collection pages.
admin.modules.breadcrumb.label: Breadcrumb
admin.modules.breadcrumb.help: Library breadcrumb in the header of detail pages.
admin.apikeys.title: API Keys
admin.apikeys.tmdb.label: TMDb API Key
admin.apikeys.tmdb.help: Required for Connected widgets that use The Movie Database. Leave empty if not needed. Accepted formats: 32-character hexadecimal key (v3), or v4 bearer token starting with "ey".
admin.apikeys.tmdb.error: Invalid TMDb key format. Expected: 32 hexadecimal characters, a v4 bearer token, or leave empty.
admin.cache.title: Cache
admin.cache.sessionttl.label: Session cache TTL (minutes)
admin.cache.sessionttl.help: How long a user's home screen layout is kept before it is rebuilt, counted from when it was built. Saving this page applies changes at once. Personalized picks are recomputed once a day and after a title is finished, not on this schedule.
admin.cache.tmdbrefresh.label: TMDb refresh interval (hours)
admin.cache.tmdbrefresh.help: How often TMDb data is refreshed. Increase to reduce external API calls; decrease for fresher content.
admin.tmdbcache.title: TMDb Cache
admin.tmdbcache.help: Status of the cached TMDb data used by Connected widgets.
admin.tmdbcache.pageshint: Each page is about 20 items from TMDb, so "Pages: 3" fetches roughly 60 items for that list.
admin.widgets.title: Widgets
admin.widgets.help: Drag a section by its handle, type its position or use the arrows to change the display order. Changes take effect after saving.
admin.addsection.title: Add a section
admin.addsection.type.label: Section type
admin.addsection.error: Please choose a section type before adding.
admin.save.failed: The configuration was not saved. Check the sections marked in red, then save again.
admin.preview.hidden.minitems: Hidden on the home screen: fewer than {min} items.
admin.preview.hidden.novalue: Hidden on the home screen for you: no value to show yet.
admin.value.label: Value
admin.value.error: A value is required for this section.
admin.personalized.note: Section names are generated per user (e.g. "Because you watched ...").
admin.name.label: Display name
admin.name.help: Leave empty to use the default name.
admin.discover.genre.label: Genre
admin.discover.sortby.label: Sort by
admin.discover.sortby.title: Title
admin.rewards.error: A Rewards section needs a ceremony or a category.
admin.rewards.help: At least one of Ceremony or Category is required. Data comes from Wikidata and may not cover every ceremony/year. For better search results, type the full name (e.g. "Academy Award for Best Picture" rather than "Academy").
admin.minitems.label: Min items
admin.minitems.help: Section hidden if below this count.
admin.maxitems.label: Max items
admin.viewmode.label: View mode
admin.sort.label: Sort order
admin.sort.help: Order of the cards in this section. Random changes once a day and is the same on every visit of that day.
admin.watchlist.title: Watchlist
admin.watchlist.autoremove.label: Remove watched titles from the watchlist
admin.watchlist.autoremove.help: A movie leaves the watchlist when its playback finishes, a series when its last unwatched episode does. The watchlist is Jellyfin's "liked" list, which other plugins read too: Jellyfin Enhanced, for one, syncs it to Seerr, so a removed title also leaves the Seerr watchlist. Untick to never change it automatically.
admin.excludewatched.label: Exclude already watched
admin.excludewatched.help: When enabled, titles the user has already watched are not recommended.
admin.byw.scope.label: Scope
admin.byw.scope.help: Restricts which recently watched titles can trigger this section.
admin.tmdbregion.label: Region
admin.tmdbstatus.nowplaying.help: Shows only the films in theaters that are already in your library.
admin.tmdbrefresh.inprogress: Refresh started, this may take a few seconds...
admin.tmdbrefresh.failed: Failed to trigger refresh. See browser console for details.
admin.local.itemtypes.label: Show
admin.seasonal.theme.label: Theme
admin.seasonal.startdate.label: Start date (MM-DD)
admin.seasonal.enddate.label: End date (MM-DD)
admin.seasonal.date.help: Recurring every year. Format: MM-DD (e.g. 10-31 for October 31). An end date earlier than the start date wraps across the new year (e.g. 12-26 to 01-06).
admin.seasonal.date.error: Both dates are required, in MM-DD format (e.g. 10-31).
admin.seasonal.genre.label: Genres
admin.seasonal.tag.label: Tags
admin.seasonal.filter.help: Separate several values with | (for example Horror|Horreur). A title matches any of them; with both genres and tags, it needs one of each. A section with neither stays hidden.
client.watchlist.title: Watchlist
client.watchlist.emptySubtitle: Items you bookmark from a card, the "More" menu, or the detail page show up here.
client.history.title: History
client.history.emptySubtitle: Movies you finish watching show up here.
client.progress.title: Progress
client.progress.emptySubtitle: Watch an episode of a series and it will show up here.
client.statistics.title: Statistics
client.usersettings.title: JellyUX
client.usersettings.enabledHelp: Untick to get Jellyfin’s own home screen, tabs and pages back for your account.
client.usersettings.sectionsHelp: These sections replace the “Home screen section” lists above, which are hidden while JellyUX is on.
client.usersettings.empty: Your administrator has not let you change any section.
client.usersettings.saveFailed: JellyUX settings could not be saved. Check your connection, then save again.
client.error.title: Couldn’t load {name}
client.error.subtitle: The server did not respond. Check your connection, then try again.
client.chunk.drift: Jellyfin Web has changed: JellyUX went back to the native home screen.
client.chunk.reloading: JellyUX: updating cached files, reloading the page.
client.chunk.stale: JellyUX cannot show its home page: a cache between this browser and the server (CDN or proxy) still serves an old copy of the page. The server administrator should purge it.
